_comment: Hand-written CV material with no website equivalent: employment, education,
community service, skills, bibliometrics, and the pre-website supervision.
Read directly by cv/cv.typ, and exposed to Hugo as .Site.Data.cv.* should any
of it ever gain a page. Everything the website already knows — publications,
grants, theses, courses, projects — is pulled from its own source of truth by
tools/build-cv.py and must NOT be duplicated here.
Entries share one shape, neat-cv's: title, date, institution, location,
description (a string, or a list rendered as bullets).
